subject: Interop smoke-test & architecture deep-dive — session booking and preflight
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom@edgescale.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interop smoke-test & architecture deep-dive — proposed windows

Hi Tom —

Really appreciated the discovery call yesterday. From what you shared about the inference surface and your multi-region staging topology, I think a combined interop smoke-test + architecture deep-dive will be most valuable: 90 minutes total — 45min architecture walkthrough (high-level topology, networking, auth/keys) + 30min hands-on smoke test (small traffic, model variant fallback) + 15min next steps / rollout questions.

Proposed windows (all in PDT):
- Wed Jun 30: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Thu Jul 1: 08:30–10:00 or 16:00–17:30

Can you confirm who from EdgeScale would join? It helps to have your infra/network lead and the person who owns service-to-service auth (mTLS/API keys). We will bring a solutions engineer and our platform engineer for hands-on validation.

Preflight items (attached checklist):
- Small test cluster creds (read-only) or a VPN jump host
- Public egress IPs / NAT ranges so we can whitelist in the test environment
- A short topology diagram (png) if you have one

I attached a short smoke-test checklist and a sample agenda. If any of the proposed windows don't work, send two alternatives and we’ll find a slot.

Thanks — look forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: redwood-smoke-test-checklist.pdf (8 KB)

Diego —

Thanks, this looks great. We definitely want both the infra and platform folks on our side — looping in Sara (infra) here. Of the windows you proposed, Jul 1 08:30–10:00 PDT would work best for us (that's 11:30–13:00 EST). If that slot is taken, Jul 1 16:00–17:30 PDT is our second choice.

We should be able to provide a small staging NAT range and a dedicated test user token for the session. Sara, can you confirm the visualization of the network diagram and whether we can stand up the test token by Friday?

Also, would you prefer we share an SSH jump host or open a restricted CIDR for the smoke test?

—Tom

Thanks — perfect. Jul 1 08:30–10:00 PDT (90m) works for our team as well — I’ve penciled it in.

Plan / owners for the session:
- EdgeScale: Sara Patel (infra) — topology, NAT ranges, test token (action: confirm by Fri Jun 25)
- EdgeScale: Tom Reynolds — product context and acceptance criteria (action: confirm list)
- Redwood: Diego Fernandez — architecture walkthrough & agenda
- Redwood: Ben Carter — hands-on smoke test, KV cache and batching checks
- Redwood: Jonas Weber — network rules and metrics validation (tracing hooks)

For the smoke test access we prefer a short-lived test token or a restricted CIDR — SSH jump is okay if you prefer but network latency can mask perf margins, so token+CIDR is our baseline recommendation.

I attached a light calendar link for Jul 1 08:30–10:00 PDT: https://calendly.com/redwood/interop-deep-dive-90m — please accept and add an internal calendar invite so notifications reach your infra team.

If you can attach the network diagram (png) and the token creation ETA that’s ideal.

Cheers,
Diego
